title: Works on my Mac, fails on EAS: Unable to resolve module ./src/Routes
symptom: Metro encountered an error: Unable to resolve module ./src/Routes / Task :app:bundleReleaseJsAndAssets FAILED on the EAS builder; builds fine locally on macOS.
expected_root_cause: Filename case differs in Git vs filesystem (routes.js committed but Routes.js on disk); macOS is case-insensitive so it works locally, the EAS Linux builder is case-sensitive so it fails — the single most common 'works on my Mac, fails on EAS' trap
expected_fix: Run npx expo export locally — it reproduces the resolution and catches the case mismatch before a cloud build; fix the casing in Git with git mv to correct the tracked name
obvious_but_wrong: assume a missing dependency / reinstall node_modules
pebble_answer: Root cause: filename case differs between Git and the filesystem — e.g. routes.js is committed but the import references Routes.js on disk. macOS is case-insensitive so the module resolves locally; the EAS Linux builder is case-sensitive so it fails. This is the single most common 'works on my Mac, fails on EAS' trap. Fix: run npx expo export locally first — it reproduces Metro's resolution and catches the case mismatch for free before you spend a cloud build. Then fix the casing in Git with git mv (correct the tracked name) so the committed filename matches the import. Do NOT assume a missing dependency or reinstall node_modules — the dependency is present; only its filename casing is wrong.
source: Expo docs, 'Troubleshoot build errors and crashes'
